source: 外研社新标准选择性必修二 Unit 3 同主题完形(童年记忆里的书店/从书信到即时消息/奶奶眼中的老镇/学用表情符号/旧时送报/书店的新生)。用词限本单元/初中/常见词,答案唯一,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。答案位由 _balance 打散。

passages.title: A Child's Bookstore Memory
passages.text: When I was young, a (1)____ of us would drop by the Rainbow Bookstore after school every day. The shop was old and (2)____, with books piled on every shelf, but we loved it. Old Casey knew every book in the store and would always (3)____ the perfect one for us from a dusty corner. We spent hours (4)____, sitting on the comfortable old furniture. Casey often (5)____ us to share our ideas by writing them on a large (6)____ in one corner. To us, the bookstore was not just a shop; it was a second (7)____. Years later, when I heard that it might (8)____, I felt heartbroken. I could still (9)____ the smell of the old pages and the sound of Casey's voice. That little store had quietly (10)____ the way I saw the world.

questions.explanation: a bunch of us 我们一群人;其余不与'人'搭配。
old and dusty 又旧又布满灰尘;其余与'old'矛盾。
pick the perfect one 挑出最合适的一本。
spent hours reading 读了几个小时。
encouraged us to share 鼓励我们分享;其余搭配或语义不通。
a large board 一块大板子,用来写评论。
a second home 第二个家,表温馨。
might close 可能关张,呼应 heartbroken。
still remember the smell 仍记得那气味。
changed the way I saw the world 改变了我看世界的方式。

passages.title: From Letters to Instant Messages
passages.text: Fifty years ago, if you wanted to send a (1)____ to a friend far away, you wrote a letter by hand. You then had to (2)____ it to the post office and wait many days for a reply. Today, everything is (3)____. A message can reach the other side of the world in a (4)____. We can add photos, voice notes and even tiny pictures called emojis to (5)____ our feelings. Young people often (6)____ with emojis instead of words, because they are quick and fun. Some older people find this strange and (7)____ that we are forgetting how to write properly. Others believe it is simply a new (8)____ of communicating. Whatever you think, one thing is (9)____: the way we keep in touch has changed for ever, and there is probably no going (10)____.

questions.explanation: send a message 发一条消息。
carry it to the post office 把信带到邮局。
everything is instant 一切都是即时的;slow 与下文矛盾。
in a second 一秒钟内,表极快。
express our feelings 表达感受。
communicate with emojis 用表情符号交流。
find strange and worry 觉得奇怪并担心,语义为负面。
a new way of communicating 一种新的交流方式。
one thing is certain 有一点是确定的。
no going back 无法回头。

passages.title: Grandmother's Old Town
passages.text: My grandmother loves to tell me how much our town has (1)____ over the years. When she was young, she says, it was just a (2)____ village by the river. There were only a few low houses made of (3)____, and most people made a (4)____ from farming. There were no tall buildings, no traffic and no bright lights at (5)____. Then, decade by decade, everything began to (6)____. New roads were laid, factories opened, and skyscrapers slowly (7)____ where the green fields had once been. Today our town is a busy (8)____ full of shops and offices. Grandmother is proud of the change, though she sometimes (9)____ the quiet lanes of her childhood. 'Times always change,' she tells me with a smile, 'and we must learn to change (10)____ them.'

questions.explanation: how much our town has changed 镇子变了多少。
a small village 一个小村庄,与后文 busy city 形成对比。
houses made of brick 砖房。
made a living from farming 靠种田谋生。
bright lights at night 夜晚的灯光。
everything began to change 一切开始改变。
skyscrapers slowly rose 高楼缓缓拔地而起;其余表向下或不通。
a busy city 繁忙的城市,与 village 对比。
misses the quiet lanes 怀念安静的小巷。
change with them 随时代一起改变。

passages.title: Learning to Use Emojis
passages.text: When my friend first sent me a message full of tiny pictures, it took me a (1)____ to understand it. I had no idea what the little symbols meant! Feeling out of (2)____, I decided to learn how to use emojis myself. I soon found that they come in different (3)____, such as faces, animals and food. Adding a smiling face to a message can show your (4)____ far better than words alone. In a way, emojis are like the (5)____ we make with our hands when we speak. Now I use them every day, and they make chatting more (6)____. Of course, I am careful not to (7)____ on them too much. In a school essay, for example, careful written words are still far more (8)____ than pictures. My teacher says emojis are fun, but they should never (9)____ proper writing. I think she is (10)____: there is a time for pictures and a time for words.

questions.explanation: took me a while 花了我一会儿。
out of touch 跟不上、脱节。
different categories 不同类别。
show your feelings 表达你的感受。
the gestures we make with our hands 我们做的手势。
more fun 更有趣;其余与积极语境矛盾。
rely on them 依赖它们。
far more useful 更有用。
never replace proper writing 永远取代不了正式书写。
she is right 她说得对。

passages.title: The Old Newspaper Round
passages.text: My uncle still remembers his first job as a boy: (1)____ newspapers before school. Every morning he got up while it was still (2)____ outside. At the printing house, the fresh papers were being (3)____ off the machines, smelling of ink. He would load them onto his old (4)____ and ride from street to street. At each house he pushed a paper through the (5)____ in the door. People waited eagerly for the news, because back then it was the only (6)____ they had. There was no Internet, and a story might be a whole day (7)____ by the time they read it. Today, my uncle says, the news arrives on our phones the (8)____ it happens. He is amazed by how fast everything has (9)____. Still, he is proud of those early mornings, and he believes that hard work never goes out of (10)____.

questions.explanation: delivering newspapers 送报纸。
still dark outside 外面天还黑,呼应早起。
being printed off the machines 正从机器上印出来。
load them onto his old bike 装到旧自行车上去骑。
through the gap in the door 从门缝塞进去。
the only source they had 他们唯一的(新闻)来源。
a whole day old 已经过了整整一天(消息变旧)。
the moment it happens 一发生就(到达)。
how fast everything has changed 一切变化有多快。
goes out of fashion 过时;此处指勤奋永不过时。

passages.title: New Life in the Old Bookstore
passages.text: The new Rainbow Bookstore is nothing like the quiet shop I remember. Under Jennifer's (1)____, it has become a lively centre for the whole community. The old wooden board in the corner has been (2)____ by a bright screen, where readers' comments pop up all day. In one room there is now a small café selling healthy (3)____ food. People come not only to buy books but also to (4)____ events such as poetry recitals and jazz (5)____. On the evening I visited, a book reading was being (6)____ in one corner while soft music played. The shop can no longer (7)____ with huge chain stores on price, so Jennifer has made it special in another (8)____. 'We sell an experience that cannot be (9)____,' she told me proudly. Looking around at the happy faces, I felt sure that the old store had found a bright new (10)____.

questions.explanation: under Jennifer's leadership 在珍妮弗的领导下。
has been replaced by a screen 被屏幕取代。
healthy organic food 健康的有机食品。
attend events 参加活动。
jazz concerts 爵士音乐会。
a book reading was being delivered 朗读会正在进行。
compete with chain stores on price 在价格上与连锁店竞争。
special in another way 以另一种方式与众不同。
an experience that cannot be downloaded 无法被下载的体验。
a bright new future 崭新光明的未来。
